import asyncio
import logging

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, Browser, Page, Locator

# Configure logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format='%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s')


class BasePage:
    """
    Base Page class with common methods for all pages.
    """

    def __init__(self, page: Page, base_url: str):
        """
        Initializes the BasePage object.

        Args:
            page (Page): The Playwright Page object.
            base_url (str): The base URL of the application.
        """
        self.page = page
        self.base_url = base_url

    async def goto(self, path: str = "") -> None:
        """
        Navigates to the specified path relative to the base URL.

        Args:
            path (str, optional): The path to navigate to. Defaults to "".

        Raises:
            Exception: If navigation fails.
        """
        url = f"{self.base_url}/{path}" if path else self.base_url
        logging.info(f"Navigating to: {url}")
        try:
            await self.page.goto(url)
            await self.page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")  # Ensure content is loaded
            logging.info(f"Successfully navigated to: {url}")
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Failed to navigate to {url}: {e}")
            raise

    async def get_title(self) -> str:
        """
        Gets the title of the current page.

        Returns:
            str: The title of the page.

        Raises:
            Exception: If unable to retrieve the title.
        """
        try:
            title = await self.page.title()
            logging.info(f"Page title: {title}")
            return title
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Failed to get page title: {e}")
            raise

    async def wait_for_element(self, selector: str, timeout: int = 5000) -> None:
        """
        Waits for an element to be present on the page.

        Args:
            selector (str): The CSS selector of the element to wait for.
            timeout (int, optional): The maximum time to wait in milliseconds. Defaults to 5000.

        Raises:
            Exception: If the element is not found within the timeout.
        """
        logging.info(f"Waiting for element: {selector} (timeout: {timeout}ms)")
        try:
            await self.page.wait_for_selector(selector, timeout=timeout)
            logging.info(f"Element found: {selector}")
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Element not found: {selector} after {timeout}ms: {e}")
            raise

    async def click_element(self, selector: str) -> None:
        """
        Clicks on an element identified by the given selector.

        Args:
            selector (str): The CSS selector of the element to click.

        Raises:
            Exception: If the element is not clickable or not found.
        """
        logging.info(f"Clicking element: {selector}")
        try:
            await self.page.click(selector)
            logging.info(f"Clicked element: {selector}")
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Failed to click element {selector}: {e}")
            raise


class ExamplePage(BasePage):
    """
    Page object class for https://example.com.
    """

    def __init__(self, page: Page):
        """
        Initializes the ExamplePage object.

        Args:
            page (Page): The Playwright Page object.
        """
        super().__init__(page, "https://example.com")

    # Heading Section
    async def get_main_heading_text(self) -> str:
        """
        Gets the text of the main heading (<h1>) element.

        Returns:
            str: The text of the main heading.

        Raises:
            Exception: If the heading element is not found.
        """
        selector = "h1"
        try:
            await self.wait_for_element(selector)
            heading_text = await self.page.locator(selector).inner_text()
            logging.info(f"Main heading text: {heading_text}")
            return heading_text
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Failed to get main heading text: {e}")
            raise

    # Navigation Section
    async def click_more_info_link(self) -> None:
        """
        Clicks on the 'More Information' link.

        Raises:
            Exception: If the link element is not found or clickable.
        """
        selector = "a[href='/more-info']"
        try:

            return is_visible
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Error checking visibility of 'More Information' link: {e}")
            return False  # Return False in case of an error
